title: Error in dynamicISF algorithm
symptom: In version dev3.3.0 build on 14.01.24 the dynamicISF gives an abnormal result. The dynamicISF adjustment factor changes to 0 without user interaction, causing an abnormal high ISF.
cause: The dynamicISF adjustment factor was set to 0 without user interaction, possibly due to a bug in the app. The code only reads the value, so it should not change by itself, but multiple users reported it happening after updating to latest dev.
fix: Manually set the dynamicISF adjustment factor back to the desired value (e.g., 100% or previous value like 80) in preferences. A commit was made to address the issue.
evidence_quote: I've entered preferences to check the value (did not edit it), and it was zero. I've set it back to the normal value, but 1 loop run was affected, and I had a similar high ISF.
